text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
No... let us wait... just a little 
longer...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! But really, I want you to eat it 
as soon as possible...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Because it's a present pickled with utmost 
BAKUSHIN speed to celebrate Chitose-san's 
birthday!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho... That is precisely why— I wish to 
savor it... with the perfect seasoning and 
benefits—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san personally made this... 
Fukujinzuke pickles designed specially... 
to go well with my medicinal curry...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~~ But still...! I want to hear what 
you think of the taste right away, I'm 
Bakushin-fidgeting with anticipation~~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
In that case... shall I brew some 
medicinal tea in my room to soothe your 
mind—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Right about when you finish your break... 
the Bakushin pickles... should be 
marinated to perfection as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then let us take a bakushin-speed 
break!! Onward! Bakushiiin to the room!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: Ho ho ho... Now, now... no need to rush...
